Subject: Annual committed spend — invoice cadence & PO# 45721

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the onboarding call yesterday. Our finance team asked me to capture the agreed committed spend and confirm an invoicing cadence we can plug into our AP system. PO# 45721 is being issued today. Could you send: 1) the proposed invoice dates for the annual prepay (we discussed a staggered approach tied to product milestones), 2) any required VAT/evidence fields we need to include on our PO, and 3) a sample invoice pdf that matches the format our AP team will receive?

We need the first invoice by end of August to hit our month-end close. Also flag any early-drawdown triggers (e.g., exceed usage thresholds) so we can pre-approve transfer windows.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our AP lead is cc'd.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Langston
Director, IT Procurement
AcmeCo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Annual committed spend — invoice cadence & PO# 45721

Hi Sarah — thanks, and welcome aboard.

High level proposal (attached CSV and summary PDF):
- Total committed prepay: $360,000 for 12 months (Deal DL-98432).
- Invoice cadence: 3 invoices: Aug 31 (initial tranche, 40%), Jan 31 (middle tranche, 30%), Apr 30 (final tranche, 30%).
- Drawdown mechanics: each invoice creates a ledger credit. Consumption pulls down from that credit; when remaining credit < 10% we notify AcmeCo and propose a top-up invoice or a short-term charge.
- Early-drawdown: usage spikes > 150% of expected monthly burn will trigger an interim invoice (billing window + 5 business days) unless you pre-authorize a buffer.

VAT / tax fields we need on the PO (for AP):
- Billing name & legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID: US EIN 12-3456789
- Billing address: 100 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- For non-US entities we will require VAT registration evidence; for AcmeCo (US) VAT is not applicable but please include tax-exempt or registered entity flag to avoid EU VAT workflows.

I've attached: prepay-drawdown-schedule.csv (line-level invoice schedule) and SOW-commitment-summary.pdf (human-friendly). Also included a sample invoice PDF that mirrors our template — invoice-45721-20260831.pdf.

Ben / Grace — can you confirm the Jan tranche split flexibility and the AP field list looks complete? If you want to re-time the middle tranche into two semi-monthly invoices for cashflow, propose the exact split and we'll update the invoice numbering and ledger mapping.

Next step: once Sarah confirms, I'll issue the Aug 31 invoice and send wiring instructions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

If Sarah confirms, I'll sign off and Marissa can generate updated invoice numbers. Also please ensure the invoice metadata includes our internal deal tag DL-98432 and the subscription ID so our accounting team can auto-apply.

—Ben

All — FYI from finance. VAT: since AcmeCo is US-registered, we will not apply EU VAT. Please ensure the PO includes a US billing address and the legal entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.) to avoid cross-border tax rules. For our ledger: map the invoice lines to GL code 5601 (Prepaid Customer Credits) and include the deal_id and subscription id in the invoice memo field.

On the Jan split: splitting Jan into Jan 31 / Feb 15 is fine operationally. I'll pre-create both invoice numbers and confirm with AR once Marissa publishes.

Also: for electronic acceptance, we prefer a DocuSign envelope for the SOW so our procurement tool can attach canonical acceptance to the PO. Sarah — would you prefer DocuSign or a signed PDF?

Grace O'Connor
